Case: Patient D is a 50-year-old Hispanic man presenting with severe left posterior thigh pain. On physical examination, you discover that he has diminished sensation in several dermatomes spanning his left leg. You obtain an MRI of the lumbosacral spine and discover a large parasacral mass extending toward his pelvic floor.
